categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Bluetrum Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, design, and sales of wireless audio SoC chips. Its product portfolio includes Bluetooth earphone chips, Bluetooth speaker chips, smart wearable chips, wireless microphone chips, digital audio chips, toy voice chips, AIoT chips, and AI voice recognition chips. These products are widely applied in TWS Bluetooth earphones, neckband earphones, headphones, Bluetooth speakers, in-car Bluetooth audio, TV audio, smart wearables, wireless microphones, voice toys, and IoT devices.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company adopts a fabless model focusing on chip design and development, outsourcing wafer manufacturing, packaging, and testing to specialized foundries. It uses the open-source RISC-V instruction set architecture for chip development, integrating proprietary Bluetooth dual-mode baseband and RF, FM transceiver, audio codec, power management, and interface circuits. Key technologies include low-power Bluetooth dual-mode RF, Bluetooth TWS communication, advanced audio codec and processing, intelligent power management, and AI-enhanced noise cancellation algorithms. The company continuously upgrades chip performance through process improvements and algorithm innovation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Bluetrum serves a diverse customer base including well-known terminal brands such as Xiaomi, 1MORE, realme, Baseus, Edifier, Tencent QQ Music, Transsion, Meizu, Philips, Nokia, Motorola, Lenovo, Audio-Technica, Himalaya, boAt, Noise, Walmart, iFlytek, and TCL. Its chips are integrated into consumer electronics like Bluetooth earphones, speakers, smart wearables, and IoT devices. The company targets both white-label manufacturers and branded terminal customers, with a strategic focus on expanding penetration into high-end brand clients.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with its headquarters in Shenzhen and a branch in Zhuhai. Its sales and customer base extend domestically across regions such as South China and other parts of China. The company also serves international markets through its terminal brand customers and white-label channels, with products reaching emerging markets including India and other developing regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Bluetrum operates in the midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain as an IC design (fabless) company. It focuses on chip design and development while outsourcing wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing to external foundries and subcontractors. The company supplies chips to downstream terminal product manufacturers and brand customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous R&D investment to accelerate product iteration and technology upgrades, focusing on low-power, high-performance wireless audio SoC chips. It prioritizes RISC-V based chip architecture, Bluetooth 5.4 and LE Audio standards, AI-enhanced noise cancellation, and integration of Wi-Fi and Bluetooth combo chips for IoT applications. Bluetrum is expanding into smart wearables, smart home, and AIoT markets, aiming to enhance chip integration, reduce power consumption, and improve audio quality. It also invests in talent development and innovation incentives to sustain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Bluetrum generates revenue primarily through the sales of its integrated circuit chips to OEMs, ODMs, and branded terminal manufacturers. Sales are conducted via both direct sales and distribution channels (dealers). The company does not engage in manufacturing but licenses and sells chip designs embedded in customer products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Bluetrum is positioned as a leading domestic IC design company specializing in wireless audio SoC chips with strong market competitiveness. It holds a significant market share with over 1.4 billion wireless audio chips sold in 2023. The company is recognized for its balanced product performance, cost-effectiveness, and advanced technology adoption, including early adoption of RISC-V architecture. It competes with other domestic and international IC design firms in the Bluetooth audio and AIoT chip sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, Bluetrum achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.447 billion, representing a 33.98% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders reached RMB 251.7 million, up 78.64% from the previous year. The company’s total assets grew by 29.5% to RMB 4.8 billion, and net assets increased by 6.14% to RMB 3.76 billion. R&D investment accounted for 11.35% of revenue, reflecting a strong growth trajectory and expanding scale.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Bluetrum emphasizes high integration, low power consumption, compact size, and comprehensive performance balance in its chip products. Leveraging open-source RISC-V architecture and proprietary Bluetooth technologies, the company offers cost-effective, customizable solutions with strong audio processing capabilities and advanced noise cancellation. Its products support rapid secondary development, enabling customers to reduce development costs and accelerate time-to-market. Bluetrum’s broad product portfolio and strong brand partnerships provide differentiated value in wireless audio and AIoT markets.
